text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired -> SEV2. Service: edge-loadbalancer (tls-handshake/failing-targets). PD alert: PD#INC-9821.
Maya: Acked. I'm oncall. pulling logs now.
Diego: seeing lots of TLS handshake 0x5 errors from edge in the last 5m. LB marked backend targets unhealthy.
Lena: any regional pattern?
Diego: mostly eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. us-west looks okay.
Raj: DNS TTL change rollback completed earlier today — could be propagation + old cert references?
Sam: timeline: at 10:12 UTC weight shift to EDGE-A for maintenance, at 10:18 errors spike. correlation looks strong.
Maya: quick customer impact note: some API calls failing with 502/524, embedders seeing timeouts intermittently. Not a full outage but increased errors.
Priya: CS: we have two customers reporting degraded response times for user-facing inference endpoints. Raising to priority.
incident-bot: Automated runbook link: <https://runbooks.redwood.ai/edge-tls-lb-fallback>. Suggested first step: check LB target health and cert validity.
Diego: checking target health:
```
aws elb describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:... | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | {id: .Target.Id, state: .TargetHealth.State, reason: .TargetHealth.Reason}'
```
Diego: many targets show State: unhealthy, Reason: TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE.
Lena: pulling edge proxy logs for handshake errors, sample: `TLS error: unknown certificate` followed by `alert handshake failure`.
Maya: confirm cert rotates? Which cert served on EDGE-A?
Sam: EDGE-A was running cert v2026-03-08. We rotated certs on EDGE-B yesterday but not A. Strange.
Raj: DNS: We pushed a weighted traffic change 2h ago with TTL 60. Some caches may still point to old origin.
Diego: mitigation idea: temporarily move weight away from EDGE-A to EDGE-B which has known-good certs. Can we shift 90% to EDGE-B?
Maya: I can initiate weight shift. Doing gradual: 50% -> 90% over 3m.
Priya: please post exact commands so CS can paste to status page.
Maya: Command (internal):
```
redwood infra lb set-weight --pool edge --region eu-west-1 --from EDGE-A --to EDGE-B --percent 90 --reason "mitigate tls-handshake failures"
```
Maya: rolling now.
Diego: watch logs.
Lena: after weight shift, handshake errors drop ~75% on EDGE-A stream. TL;DR looks promising.
Sam: open question: why did EDGE-A certificate present old chain? config drift?
Raj: there's a config sync job that failed earlier on EDGE-A at 09:58 UTC: `sync-service exit 1`. Ops ticket #OPS-447. Possibly related.
Maya: For immediate customer impact: marking as partial degraded for EU/APAC. Updating status page: "Partial degraded due to TLS handshake errors on EU/APAC edge; mitigation in progress."
Maya: Status update posted. Link: <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9821>
Priya: patching CS message: "We're mitigating via traffic shift; we expect partial recovery within 15-30 minutes. We'll update with root cause once confirmed."
Diego: running health check script to confirm backend readiness:
```
for t in $(targets); do curl -k https://$t/health || echo $t failed; done
```
Diego: some backends still returning 502s behind EDGE-A; EDGE-B targets green.
Sam: escalated to infra-team for config sync investigation: @Raj can you own investigating sync-service failure?
Raj: on it. I already dug logs — `sync-service` failed due to disk pressure on the node and config sync aborted. Remediated by freeing space at 10:25 UTC but doesn't auto-retry.
Maya: action items: 1) keep weight on EDGE-B until config verified, 2) ensure sync-service re-run on EDGE-A, 3) rotate certs if mismatch, 4) post customer comms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: next level paged in 12m due to SEV2 policy.
Priya: sent CS update to affected customers.
Diego: re-run handshake tests after sync re-run.
Raj: manually triggered sync-service retry at 10:42 UTC. Logs show successful config fetch and cert sync completed at 10:44 UTC.
Lena: after cert sync, EDGE-A now presents cert chain v2026-03-18 (matches EDGE-B). Handshakes success rates return to baseline.
Maya: starting gradual rollback of weight back to EDGE-A: 20% increments over 6m.
Diego: monitoring metrics: error rate trending down to baseline over last 20m.
Priya: CS: customers report recovery, removing "degraded" flag from severity for some.
Sam: root cause hypothesis: earlier disk pressure caused config sync to abort, leaving EDGE-A with outdated cert chain; weight shift then exposed handshake failures under traffic. Recommend: automated retry for sync-service and alert on disk pressure.
Maya: will add retrospective notes and start post-incident trigger.
Priya: closing customer loop: email sent w/ timeline and mitigation.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (SEV2 -> mitigated). Please fill postmortem template: https://pm.redwood.ai/incidents/9821/postmortem
Sam: assigning postmortem owners: Maya + Raj + Diego.
Maya: handing off to next on-call Sam for followup docs. I'm done on primary.
Sam: ack, I'll take it from here. Thanks team. :heart:
